title.narrative: Output 3.5. Increased capacity of Member States to formulate and implement labour market programmes and employment services for transitions to decent work over the life course, with particular focus on young and older workers

description.narrative:
TVET Institutes, the National Employment Agency, and the Job Centre implement improved employment services and rights at work for youth in 2023. and in Kompong Cham and Battambang.
The Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training successfully enhanced their employment services and labor market programs through the development of the Employment Service Manual for TVET Schools and expanding employment access, career counseling, pre-employment training and services to in-school and out-of-school youth. These improvements encompassed tailored initiatives to support young and older workers, resulting in notable achievements such as increased access to decent work opportunities. The employment service was also promoted and enhanced to employee association (trade union). The ILO provided technical assistance in the design of the manual and implemented trainers’ training to support the implementation of improved employment services and the rights at work for youth in Cambodia by TVET Institutes, the National Employment Agency, and the Job Centre. This aims to improve the deliverable of public employment services and rights of youth at work promotion among Cambodian youth in 2023.
With the technical and funding support from the ILO, DGTVET has developed and endorsed the employment service manual as guidance for the TVET focal persons. ToTs were organized to roll out the implementation of this manual nationwide including employee associations. Job fairs and career guidance were organized in different provinces to open access for young people and older workers.
